_readme: Age-related facts used by scripts/09_age_analysis.py. type: measured = stated by the source; assumed = analyst judgement needed to split a published band. Retrieved 2026-10-08.

age_checked_share_of_dau.source: Roblox Q2 2026 shareholder letter: 'By the end of Q2, 57% of global DAUs have age-checked'

age_checked_mix.source: Roblox Q2 2026 shareholder letter: '35% of users who have age-checked are under 13, 38% are between the ages of 13 and 17, and 27% are O18'

u18_age_check_penetration.source: Roblox Q2 2026 shareholder letter: 'age-check penetration rates with U18 users are 60% globally and 75% in the U.S.'

us_18plus_share_of_age_checked.source: Roblox Q2 2026 shareholder letter: 'in the U.S. O18 users represented approximately one-third of age-checked DAUs'

us_18plus_monetisation_ratio_vs_u18.source: Roblox Q2 2026 shareholder letter: 'U.S. O18 users monetize over 50% higher than U18 users' (a lower bound; U.S. only)

young_cohort_monetisation.value: decline in per hour monetization most notably with younger cohorts in the U.S. and Canada
young_cohort_monetisation.source: Roblox Q2 2026 shareholder letter (no number given)

kids_select_catalogue_size.source: Roblox Q2 2026 shareholder letter: 'Kids and Select accounts now offer access to about 30,000 games, representing a nearly 50% increase since launch'

devex_usd_per_robux.source: Roblox creator docs (10,000 Robux = $38) and Roblox newsroom 2026-04-30 (42% higher rate for eligible spend by age-checked U.S. 18+ users in R15 experiences, effective 2026-06-08; game passes, Robux subscriptions, select in-game items, private servers)

value.chat: off by default; can be enabled by a linked parent once age-checked

value.who: age-checked 9-15, and anyone self-declared 9+ who has not completed an age check
value.chat: off for self-declared accounts; introduced gradually once age-checked

publishing_to_under_16.source: Roblox creator docs: kids-and-select and publish-games-and-places (GitHub main, 2026-10-08)

value.creator: account in good standing; verified (government ID if 18+); 2-step verification
value.fee_or_subscription: 1,000 Robux one-time refundable publishing fee per game, or an active 2+ month Roblox Plus/Premium subscription
value.trial_phase: the game is first made available only to age-checked users 16 and older
value.threshold: 250 unique plays by highly engaged age-checked users within a 60-day window
value.highly_engaged: account tenure + playtime in the game + a minimum purchase anywhere on Roblox in the last 60 days
value.expedited_review: 50,000 Robux per game, one-time, refundable after 90 days; 48-hour review
value.playtesters: Limited > Playtesters audience; playtesters who are Trusted Friends of an age-checked owner can enter regardless of age

share_16_17_within_13_17.source: Two of the five years in the band. Roblox does not publish a 13-15 / 16-17 split.

share_5_8_within_under_13.source: Third-party (Statista, quoting Roblox, Dec 2024): 20% of users under 9 and 20% aged 9-12. No 2026 figure.

monetisation_ratio_18plus_applies_global.source: The 'over 50% higher' statement is for the U.S.; applied to all regions for lack of anything better.

under_18_bands_monetise_equally.source: No published split of spending between under-13 and 13-17. Roblox Kids accounts carry the full set of parental spending controls, so the 5-8 band is probably overstated here.
